primary_documents.publisher: Myanmar General Administration Department; hosted by MIMU

facts.summary: Cover places Shadaw Township in Loikaw District, Kayah. History cites 22 July 1972 letter 105/7/စိပ်1 for township formation with northern, southern, middle and Thanlwin east-bank groups; 15 July 1972 letter 103/52/စိပ်1 for four town wards; and 7 June 2010 letter 200/23-19/ဦး1 changing the township to four wards, three village tracts and 20 villages. Page 10 explicitly places about three-fifths of township east of Thanlwin. Its reported coordinate box is 19°10′–19°35′N, 97°27′–97°51′E; township area 834.19 square miles. These are profile statements, not territorial annexes.

primary_documents.limits: No verified boundary map, scale, datum or georeferenced annex. The printed north bound differs from the retained original-source north bound; do not normalize them. Four historical group names becoming three tract names does not prove any east-bank exclusion. River-bank wording does not establish the six centre locations.

primary_documents.title: Langkho District regional information, October 2021–July 2022
primary_documents.publisher: GAD district report publicly linked by Shan State Government
primary_documents.access: Successful read-only web PDF text, 91 pages. Catalogue title is Langkho Township, but body is district report.

facts.summary: Report records Union Government meeting 29/2004 on 29 July 2004 separating Langkho, Mongnai, Mawkmai and Mongpan townships, with Homein and Kengtawng sub-townships, from Loilen District to form Langkho District. It then records MoHA Minister Office notification 332/2022 dated 30 April 2022 moving Mongnai Township and Kengtawng Town from Langkho to Nansang District. The remaining later district contains Langkho, Mawkmai, Mongpan and Homein Town.

primary_documents.limits: Historical retrospective and post-2019 transfer evidence. The original 2004 decision and territorial annex were not acquired. The 2022 district cannot replace the frozen 2019 complete four-child roster. Neither decision reference locates the nine candidate centres. No map scale/datum verified.
primary_documents.license: No explicit reuse license verified; short attributed factual paraphrase only.
